# Yankee Candle

> > America's best-loved candle brand offering premium scented candles, home fragrances, and signature Original Jar Candles in hundreds of fragrances.

Yankee Candle is the leading manufacturer of scented candles and home fragrance products in the United States. The company offers a wide range of candle styles including their iconic Original Jar Candles, available in seasonal and year-round fragrances designed to create ambiance and enhance home environments.

- Original Jar Candles
- Scented Candles

- Personalized Candles
- Home Fragrance
- Seasonal Scents
